messages.content: To start our IEEE-style requirement gathering for your task manager app, I'll ask a few questions about user needs and features—no technical knowledge required. Let's begin with your primary goals for task organization.

analysis_summary: A task management app to help users organize and track their tasks efficiently.

question_plan.summary: A task management app to help users organize and track their tasks efficiently.

questions.question: Who will use this task manager most often?
What should people be able to do in the first version?

introduction.purpose: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for the Task Management Application, providing a complete definition of system capabilities, user interactions, and technical specifications to guide development and implementation.

product_scope.summary: A web-based task management application that enables users to organize projects, capture requirements through guided interviews, generate structured specifications, and export deliverables in multiple formats.
business_objectives: Provide an intuitive platform for project requirement gathering and documentation
Reduce time-to-market for project specification development
Ensure consistent and standardized requirement documentation across projects
benefits: Accelerates project initiation and requirement definition processes
Reduces ambiguity in project specifications through structured interviews
Provides reusable templates and standardized output formats
goals: Deliver a fully functional web application supporting the complete project lifecycle
Achieve 90% user satisfaction for the guided interview process
Support export of both JSON and PDF artifacts for downstream integration

product_perspective.system_context: The Task Management Application operates as a standalone web application accessible through modern browsers, featuring a responsive frontend, RESTful API services, persistent data storage, and integration capabilities for external systems.

related_systems.interface_summary: Integration with third-party authentication services for user identity management and secure access control

related_systems.interface_summary: Connection to cloud-based storage solutions for secure file uploads and artifact persistence

product_functions.name: Dashboard and Project Overview
product_functions.description: Provides users with a comprehensive view of all active projects, progress tracking, and quick access to project management functions through an intuitive visual interface.

product_functions.name: Multimodal Project Intake
product_functions.description: Supports multiple input methods including text entry, file uploads, and optional voice input for capturing project requirements and supporting materials.

product_functions.name: AI-Guided Requirement Interview
product_functions.description: Offers an interactive question-and-answer workflow that systematically gathers project requirements through intelligent prompting and context-aware questioning.

product_functions.name: Structured SRS Generation
product_functions.description: Automatically generates comprehensive Software Requirements Specification documents based on collected project information and interview responses.

product_functions.name: JSON and PDF Artifact Export
product_functions.description: Enables users to download generated specifications in both machine-readable JSON format and formatted PDF documents for distribution and archival purposes.

user_classes_and_characteristics.description: Primary users who initiate projects, manage requirements, and oversee the specification process
Technical users who conduct requirement interviews and refine project specifications
Project sponsors and team members who review and provide input on requirements

user_interfaces.name: Project Dashboard
user_interfaces.description: Main landing page displaying project summaries, progress indicators, and quick access to project management functions with visual status indicators

user_interfaces.name: Project Intake Form
user_interfaces.description: Comprehensive input form supporting text entry, file uploads, and optional voice recording for initial project information capture

user_interfaces.name: Interview Workspace
user_interfaces.description: Interactive chat-style interface for conducting AI-guided requirement interviews with progress tracking and answer management

user_interfaces.name: Specification Review
user_interfaces.description: Dedicated viewing area for reviewing generated SRS documents with export options and validation status indicators

software_interfaces.description: Comprehensive RESTful API supporting all application functionality including project management, interview processing, and artifact generation
Integration interface for external authentication providers supporting OAuth2 and OpenID Connect protocols
Interface for cloud storage services supporting secure file upload, download, and management operations

description_and_priority.description: Comprehensive project lifecycle management including creation, tracking, and organization of project specifications

functional_requirements.title: Project Creation and Setup
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized users to create new projects with basic metadata including project name, description, and initial requirements
acceptance_criteria: Users can successfully create new projects with required metadata
Project creation includes validation of required fields
New projects are immediately available in the dashboard

functional_requirements.title: Project Status Tracking
functional_requirements.description: The system shall provide real-time status updates and progress indicators for all active projects
acceptance_criteria: Project status is accurately reflected in the dashboard
Progress indicators update in real-time as work progresses
Users can filter and sort projects by status and completion level

description_and_priority.description: AI-guided interactive interview process for systematically gathering and validating project requirements

functional_requirements.title: Interactive Question Flow
functional_requirements.description: The system shall present users with context-aware questions based on project type and previous responses
acceptance_criteria: Questions are relevant to the project context
Interview progress is saved automatically
Users can navigate backward to modify previous answers

functional_requirements.title: Answer Validation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall validate user responses for completeness and consistency before proceeding to subsequent questions
acceptance_criteria: Incomplete or inconsistent answers trigger validation messages
Validation rules are applied consistently across all question types
Users receive clear guidance on how to correct validation errors

description_and_priority.description: Automated generation of structured Software Requirements Specification documents from collected project information

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: SRS Template Processing
functional_requirements.description: The system shall process collected project data through standardized SRS templates to generate comprehensive requirement documents
acceptance_criteria: Generated documents follow IEEE SRS format standards
All collected project information is properly incorporated
Document generation completes within acceptable time limits

functional_requirements.title: Document Validation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall validate generated SRS documents for completeness and structural integrity before making them available for export
acceptance_criteria: Validation checks identify missing required sections
Validation results are clearly communicated to users
Users can review and address validation issues before export

description_and_priority.description: Comprehensive export capabilities supporting multiple formats for generated specification documents

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: JSON Export
functional_requirements.description: The system shall export generated SRS documents in machine-readable JSON format for integration with other systems
acceptance_criteria: JSON exports contain complete project specification data
Export files are properly formatted and validated
Downloads initiate immediately upon user request

functional_requirements.title: PDF Export
functional_requirements.description: The system shall export generated SRS documents in formatted PDF format for human consumption and archival purposes
acceptance_criteria: PDF exports maintain proper formatting and styling
Documents include proper headers, footers, and page numbering
PDF generation maintains reasonable file sizes for easy distribution

performance_requirements.description: The system shall load primary application pages within 2 seconds under normal network conditions
API responses for core functionality shall return within 1 second for 95% of requests
Document generation processes shall complete within 30 seconds for typical project specifications
The system shall support concurrent usage by at least 100 active users without performance degradation

safety_requirements.description: The system shall prevent accidental loss of active project work.
safety_requirements.hazard: Loss of project inputs or artifacts

security_requirements.description: All user authentication shall be performed through secure, industry-standard protocols
User sessions shall be protected against unauthorized access through secure token management
Uploaded files and generated artifacts shall be stored with appropriate encryption measures
API endpoints shall implement proper authorization checks based on user roles and permissions
All data transmissions shall be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher protocols

software_quality_attributes.description: Non-technical users should complete the intake and answer flow without training.

business_rules.description: Projects may only proceed to specification generation when all required interview sections are completed
Users must have appropriate permissions to access and export project artifacts
Generated SRS documents must pass validation checks before being marked as ready for export
Project ownership and access rights are determined by role-based authorization rules

database_requirements.description: The database shall store complete project metadata including project definitions, user responses, and generation history
Data retention policies shall ensure project data remains accessible for a minimum of 12 months
Database backups shall be performed daily with point-in-time recovery capabilities
The database shall support efficient querying for project search and filtering operations
Data migration procedures shall be implemented for schema changes without data loss

internationalization_requirements.description: The product should support future localization without changing the API contract.
locale_rules: ISO date formatting for API payloads

legal_requirements.description: The system shall comply with data protection regulations including GDPR for user data handling
Privacy policies shall clearly state how user data and uploaded materials are processed and stored
Terms of service shall outline user rights and responsibilities regarding generated content
The application shall maintain audit trails of user actions for compliance and security purposes

reuse_objectives.description: Reuse question planning, validation, and export modules across future agents.

additional_requirements.description: The application shall support responsive design for optimal viewing on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
Error messages shall be user-friendly and provide clear guidance for resolution
The system shall maintain comprehensive logging for troubleshooting and audit purposes
Internationalization support shall be implemented for future localization requirements

The application targets users seeking to transform project ideas into well-defined requirements through an intuitive, guided process.

introduction.purpose: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for the Task Manager application, serving as a complete specification for development, testing, and implementation.

product_scope.summary: A web-based task management system that enables users to create, organize, and track tasks through an intuitive dashboard interface with email integration for notifications.
business_objectives: Provide customers with an efficient task management solution
Deliver a responsive web application accessible through standard browsers
Support basic task management functionality in the initial release
benefits: Improved task organization and productivity for users
Centralized task management accessible from any web browser
Real-time task status updates through in-app notifications
goals: Launch a fully functional task management application within 3 months
Achieve 90% user satisfaction with the dashboard interface
Maintain system availability of 99.5% during business hours
